questions.prompt: Which country's monarchy was abolished in 1792 during a revolution?
questions.fact: It was restored twice afterwards, and the country did not settle permanently into a republic until 1870.

questions.prompt: What is the study of the origin and structure of the universe called?
questions.fact: Its central evidence is a faint microwave glow found by accident in 1964 by engineers hunting for radio interference.

questions.prompt: Which sport is played at the Maracanã stadium?
questions.fact: Its 1950 World Cup final drew a crowd estimated near 200,000, a record that will almost certainly never be broken.

questions.prompt: Which streaming series features a character called Eleven's adoptive father?
questions.fact: The character was originally scripted to die in the first season and was kept after test screenings.

questions.prompt: Which sea is the saltiest major body of open water?
questions.fact: It has almost no rivers feeding it and very high evaporation, which concentrates the salt.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the play Antigone's source trilogy, the Theban plays?
questions.fact: They were written across roughly forty years and not intended as a trilogy at all.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a load balancer?
questions.fact: It also removes failed servers from rotation automatically, which is often more valuable than the balancing itself.
